# Template: flower_anatomy
A longitudinal cross-section (half-section) of a typical flower with every named part: petals and sepals fanning off the receptacle, stamens (anther on a curving filament), the pistil/carpel (stigma, style, ovary containing ovules), receptacle and stem. Optional pollination story: pollen grains landing on the stigma with an approach arrow, a pollen tube growing down the style to an ovule, and a visiting bee. Choose this scene for requests about flower anatomy, 'parts of a flower', labelling a flower diagram, stamens and pistils/carpels, pollination and pollinators, fertilisation in plants, or how a flower makes seeds. Labels can be limited to the parts under discussion and rendered in several languages.
Parameter schema:
{
 "type": "object",
 "properties": {
  "petals": {
   "type": "integer",
   "minimum": 1,
   "maximum": 10,
   "description": "How many petals to draw, fanned across the section (default 5)."
  },
  "stamens": {
   "type": "integer",
   "minimum": 1,
   "maximum": 6,
   "description": "How many stamens (anther + filament) to draw, spread symmetrically (default 2)."
  },
  "labels": {
   "type": "array",
   "items": {
    "type": "string",
    "enum": [
     "petals",
     "sepals",
     "stamen",
     "anther",
     "filament",
     "pistil",
     "stigma",
     "style",
     "ovary",
     "ovules",
     "receptacle",
     "stem",
     "pollen",
     "pollen_tube",
     "bee"
    ]
   },
   "description": "Which parts get name labels. Default: the classic labelled diagram (petals, sepals, anther, filament, stigma, style, ovary, ovules, receptacle, stem, plus pollen/tube/bee when shown). Narrow this to just the parts the narration discusses."
  },
  "pollen": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Show pollen grains landing on the stigma plus a pollen tube growing down the style to an ovule (default false). Turn on for pollination/fertilisation explanations."
  },
  "bee": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Show a visiting bee flying in at the upper right (default false)."
  },
  "language": {
   "type": "string",
   "enum": [
    "en",
    "es",
    "fr",
    "de",
    "pt",
    "it"
   ],
   "description": "Language of the part labels (default 'en')."
  },
  "labelText": {
   "type": "object",
   "additionalProperties": {
    "type": "string"
   },
   "description": "Override individual label strings by part key, e.g. {\"pistil\":\"Carpel\"}."
  }
 },
 "additionalProperties": false
}
Element ids your commands can reference:
- stem: the two-line stem below the flower
- receptacle / receptacle_fill: the receptacle cup the flower parts sit on
- sepals: group of the sepal outlines and fills
- petals: group of all petal outlines and fills
- stamens: group of the filaments and anthers
- ovary / ovary_fill: the ovary wall and its pale interior
- ovules: group of the ovules inside the ovary
- style: group of the two style walls
- stigma / stigma_fill / stigma_hairs: the sticky stigma head at the top of the style
- pollen: group of the pollen grains (only when pollen is on)
- pollen_path: dashed arrow showing the pollen arriving at the stigma
- pollen_tube: dashed arrow of the pollen tube growing down the style to an ovule
- bee: group of the visiting bee (only when bee is on)
- label_petals / label_sepals / label_stamen / label_anther / label_filament / label_pistil / label_stigma / label_style / label_ovary / label_ovules / label_receptacle / label_stem / label_pollen / label_pollen_tube / label_bee: the part name labels
Examples:
Request: "Draw a flower in cross-section and label its parts." → params: {}
Request: "Show how pollination and fertilisation work — pollen landing on the stigma and the tube growing to the ovule, with a bee visiting." → params: {"petals":5,"pollen":true,"bee":true,"labels":["anther","stigma","style","ovary","ovules","pollen","pollen_tube","bee"]}

In YAML: `template: flower_anatomy` and `params:` per the schema above; commands name the element ids above.
